notes.title: Dyflexion Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41094464/e48e562d2287da0cac80c84378bccbb8e8679aa4.png[/img]

Break the rules of traditional shoot 'em ups in this sci-fi vertical scroll shooter where deflecting enemy projectiles is key to success!

[previewyoutube=TwXJCiPFPxo;full][/previewyoutube]

Inspired by Xevious, 1942, and Star Fox. This game features deflecting enemy projectiles back at them, dodging and deflecting your way through obstacles, encountering epic boss battles, online leaderboards, and a tutorial level.

notes.title: Online Leaderboards and Detering Hackers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41094464/0cc0bca3c93f74bea562e1cc96ec31819306389c.png[/img]
The official online scoreboards are complete and work has started on the steam, itch, and kartridge API's. At this time, I would like to briefly share the techniques I've incorporated into the game to deter hackers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41094464/247061932a451d07d2e4fd121e213ab2dcfc1e24.jpg[/img]
All major variables that affect gameplay have been given a duplicate to be checked against. If there is a difference between the two, the application will quit. The duplicated variable is encrypted using a math formula that is randomly generated each time the game starts; making it next to impossible for users to change variables in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41094464/1dcddc43272e2c8d8ec7278b9384a081ba7b2a86.jpg[/img]
Communication between the application and the website hosting the scoreboards is encrypted using 256 bit encryption. The PHP scripts are also password protected. Anyone who is logging http requests will probably never be able to manipulate scores through that method.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41094464/c3163b0648cc46f2f2cc0ac53a7bfdb5dca0ec7d.jpg[/img]
Lastly for any skilled hackers with decompilers, I've obfuscated my code to make it hell to read. So players can feel confident that the online scoreboards reflect true scores.

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer & Release Date
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xJ-2Mcw0vjk;full][/previewyoutube]
Checkout the new gameplay trailer for Dyflexion. It showcases new levels, enemies, bosses, and obstacles. The development is wrapping up with the final to-do list which includes modifications for difficulties , intermission screens / story screens / credits, a few more music tracks, and adding Steam API for achievements and leaderboards. The game is on track to be released March 9th, 2022. Don't miss Steam Next Fest February 21 - 28th 2022, Dyflexion will be showcased there along with a public Demo. Please help support this project by voting for it as the Indie of the Year 2021 [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/dyflexion]here[/url].

notes.title: DevGAMM Fall 2021 Game Industry Conference
notes.content: Dyflexion (Formerly known as Aberration) has been submitted to the DevGAMM gaming conference, one of the biggest gaming conferences in Eastern Europe. The conference will be online and basic access is free. Aberration has applied for the DevGAMM awards and streaming showcase.
